      FROM chunks_fts WHERE chunks_fts MATCH ?1
      ORDER BY score, rowid LIMIT 1000
    ), keyword_matches AS (
      
    SELECT c.chunk_uid, c.doc_uid, c.text, d.source AS source,
           COALESCE(src.kind, 'unregistered') AS source_kind,
           c.title, c.document_date,
           c.client, c.category, c.top_folder, c.platform,
           d.source_id, d.uri, d.entity_slug, d.content_hash, d.date_source, d.date_reliable,
           d.text_source, d.text_reliable, d.meta AS authority_meta,
           (SELECT head.text FROM chunks head
             WHERE head.doc_uid = d.doc_uid AND head.chunk_ix = 0 LIMIT 1) AS authority_document_head,
           CASE WHEN d.date_source = 'calendar:event_start' AND json_valid(d.meta)
                THEN json_extract(d.meta, '$.start') END AS occurred_at,
           top.score AS score, top.rowid AS _keyword_rowid
      FROM keyword_candidates top
    JOIN chunks c ON c.id = top.rowid
    JOIN documents d ON d.doc_uid = c.doc_uid
    LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.name = d.source
      WHERE 1 = 1 AND (COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(d.meta) THEN json_extract(d.meta,'$.connector') END,'')<>'custom_api' OR EXISTS (

           AND current_memory.successor_content_hash=d.content_hash
           AND current_memory.channel=json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via')
           AND (
    (d.source='owner-notes'
      AND d.category='lesson'
      AND json_valid(d.meta)
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.category')='lesson'
      AND (
        (json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via')='local_mcp'
          AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.written_by')='owner_assistant'

        OR

      a.currency,a.feed_mode,a.balance_role,a.basis_state,c.coverage_status,c.covered_from,c.covered_to,
      c.basis_state AS coverage_basis,i.last_synced_at,i.status AS institution_status,
      b.state AS backfill_state,
      CASE WHEN (c.coverage_status='complete' AND c.basis_note LIKE 'Read from a bank export covering %')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM simplefin_account_assignments x
          WHERE x.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND x.account_ref=a.external_ref
            AND a.source_feed=('bank-feed:'||x.item_ref) AND (
              NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM simplefin_sync_windows w WHERE w.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND w.item_ref=x.item_ref)
              OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM simplefin_sync_windows w WHERE w.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND w.item_ref=x.item_ref
                AND (w.state<>'promoted' OR w.revision<>w.staging_revision OR w.errlist_json<>'[]'
                  OR substr(w.revision,1,17)<>'posted-history-2:'))))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS coverage_review_required,
      CASE WHEN a.feed_mode='live' AND c.coverage_status='complete' AND c.covered_from IS NULL
        AND c.basis_state='confirmed' AND c.provenance='feed' AND c.source_feed=a.source_feed
        AND i.status='connected' AND i.removed_at IS NULL
        AND b.state='complete' AND b.provider_history_state='HISTORICAL_UPDATE_COMPLETE'
        AND b.unread_lines=0 AND b.requested_days BETWEEN 1 AND 730
        AND b.queued_at<=b.finished_at AND b.finished_at=i.last_synced_at
        AND substr(b.finished_at,1,10)=c.covered_to
        AND date(substr(b.queued_at,1,10),'+0 days')=substr(b.queued_at,1,10)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plaid_sync_windows w WHERE w.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND w.item_ref=i.item_ref)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_transactions t WHERE t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
          AND t.account_slug=a.account_slug AND t.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND t.removed_at IS NULL)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_balance_snapshots z WHERE z.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND z.account_slug=a.account_slug)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_balance_snapshots z WHERE z.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND z.account_slug=a.account_slug
          AND (z.current_minor IS NULL OR z.current_minor<>0 OR COALESCE(z.available_minor,0)<>0
            OR z.basis_state<>'confirmed' OR z.currency<>'USD'))
        THEN date(substr(b.queued_at,1,10),printf('-%d days',b.requested_days-1)) END AS empty_provider_from,
      l.manual_account_slug AS link_manual,l.live_account_slug AS link_live,l.identity_json AS link_identity,
      (SELECT json_object('id',r.id,'kind',r.kind,'role',r.role,
  'reviewer',r.reviewer,'source',r.source,'reviewed_at',r.reviewed_at,'revoked_at',r.revoked_at,
  'identity_json',r.identity_json,'identity_matches',r.identity_json=json_array(a.tenant_id,a.id,a.account_slug,a.entity_slug,
  a.mask,a.currency,a.feed_mode,a.external_ref,a.source_feed,a.institution))
  FROM fin_account_kind_reviews r WHERE r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.account_id=a.id
  ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS account_kind_review_json
    FROM fin_accounts a
    JOIN fin_entities e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.entity_slug=a.entity_slug
      AND e.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND e.relationship='owned' AND e.basis_state='confirmed'
    LEFT JOIN fin_account_coverage c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.account_slug=a.account_slug
      AND c.superseded_by_id IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN bank_feed_items i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND a.source_feed=('bank-feed:'||i.item_ref)
    LEFT JOIN bank_feed_backfill b ON b.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND b.item_ref=i.item_ref
    LEFT JOIN fin_account_links l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.unlinked_at IS NULL
      AND (l.manual_account_slug=a.account_slug OR l.live_account_slug=a.account_slug)
    WHERE a.tenant_id=? AND a.superseded_by_id IS NULL
    ORDER BY a.entity_slug,a.account_slug LIMIT ?

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT t.id,t.account_slug AS source_account_slug,
      json_extract(m.value,'$.effective') AS effective_account_slug,
      json_extract(m.value,'$.last_synced_at') AS last_synced_at,
      t.posted_on,t.amount_minor,t.direction,t.currency,t.description,t.payee,t.category,t.category_basis_state,t.basis_state,
      CASE WHEN t.provenance='extracted' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM fin_transactions other WHERE other.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND other.account_slug=t.account_slug
          AND other.provenance='extracted' AND other.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND other.removed_at IS NULL
          AND other.pending=0 AND other.posted_on=t.posted_on AND other.amount_minor=t.amount_minor
          AND other.direction=t.direction AND other.currency=t.currency
          AND (other.external_id IS NULL)<>(t.external_id IS NULL)
      ) ELSE 0 END AS export_overlap_review
    FROM json_each(?1) m CROSS JOIN fin_transactions t INDEXED BY idx_fin_transactions_account ON t.account_slug=json_extract(m.value,'$.slug')
    WHERE t.tenant_id=?2 AND t.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND t.removed_at IS NULL AND t.pending=0
      AND (json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_from') IS NULL OR t.posted_on IS NULL OR
        NOT (t.posted_on BETWEEN json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_from') AND json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_to')))
      AND (json_extract(m.value,'$.include_from') IS NULL OR t.posted_on IS NULL OR
        t.posted_on BETWEEN json_extract(m.value,'$.include_from') AND json_extract(m.value,'$.include_to'))
      AND (?5 IS NULL OR (t.amount_minor = ?5 AND t.direction='inflow') OR t.basis_state<>'confirmed' OR t.posted_on IS NULL)
     AND t.posted_on BETWEEN ?3 AND ?4
    UNION ALL SELECT t.id,t.account_slug AS source_account_slug,
      json_extract(m.value,'$.effective') AS effective_account_slug,
      json_extract(m.value,'$.last_synced_at') AS last_synced_at,
      t.posted_on,t.amount_minor,t.direction,t.currency,t.description,t.payee,t.category,t.category_basis_state,t.basis_state,
      CASE WHEN t.provenance='extracted' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM fin_transactions other WHERE other.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND other.account_slug=t.account_slug
          AND other.provenance='extracted' AND other.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND other.removed_at IS NULL
          AND other.pending=0 AND other.posted_on=t.posted_on AND other.amount_minor=t.amount_minor
          AND other.direction=t.direction AND other.currency=t.currency
          AND (other.external_id IS NULL)<>(t.external_id IS NULL)
      ) ELSE 0 END AS export_overlap_review
    FROM json_each(?1) m CROSS JOIN fin_transactions t INDEXED BY idx_fin_transactions_account ON t.account_slug=json_extract(m.value,'$.slug')
    WHERE t.tenant_id=?2 AND t.superseded_by_id IS NULL AND t.removed_at IS NULL AND t.pending=0
      AND (json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_from') IS NULL OR t.posted_on IS NULL OR
        NOT (t.posted_on BETWEEN json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_from') AND json_extract(m.value,'$.exclude_to')))
      AND (json_extract(m.value,'$.include_from') IS NULL OR t.posted_on IS NULL OR
        t.posted_on BETWEEN json_extract(m.value,'$.include_from') AND json_extract(m.value,'$.include_to'))
      AND (?5 IS NULL OR (t.amount_minor = ?5 AND t.direction='inflow') OR t.basis_state<>'confirmed' OR t.posted_on IS NULL)
     AND t.posted_on IS NULL
    ) LIMIT ?6

WITH keyword_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT rowid, bm25(chunks_fts) AS score
      FROM chunks_fts WHERE chunks_fts MATCH ?1
      ORDER BY score, rowid LIMIT 1000
    ), keyword_matches AS (
      
    SELECT c.chunk_uid, c.doc_uid, c.text, d.source AS source,
           COALESCE(src.kind, 'unregistered') AS source_kind,
           c.title, c.document_date,
           c.client, c.category, c.top_folder, c.platform,
           d.source_id, d.uri, d.entity_slug, d.content_hash, d.date_source, d.date_reliable,
           d.text_source, d.text_reliable, d.meta AS authority_meta,
           (SELECT head.text FROM chunks head
             WHERE head.doc_uid = d.doc_uid AND head.chunk_ix = 0 LIMIT 1) AS authority_document_head,
           CASE WHEN d.date_source = 'calendar:event_start' AND json_valid(d.meta)
                THEN json_extract(d.meta, '$.start') END AS occurred_at,
           top.score AS score, top.rowid AS _keyword_rowid
      FROM keyword_candidates top
    JOIN chunks c ON c.id = top.rowid
    JOIN documents d ON d.doc_uid = c.doc_uid
    LEFT JOIN sources src ON src.name = d.source
      WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.document_date >= ?3 AND c.document_date <= ?4 AND (COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(d.meta) THEN json_extract(d.meta,'$.connector') END,'')<>'custom_api' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM custom_api_current_jobs custom_api_current
    JOIN custom_api_document_versions custom_api_version
      ON custom_api_version.source=custom_api_current.source
     AND custom_api_version.job_id=custom_api_current.job_id
     WHERE custom_api_current.source=d.source
       AND custom_api_version.logical_source_id=CASE WHEN json_valid(d.meta) THEN json_extract(d.meta,'$.custom_api_source_id') END
       AND custom_api_version.document_source_id=d.source_id
  ))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM memory_supersessions old_memory
       WHERE old_memory.predecessor_doc_uid=d.doc_uid
         AND old_memory.predecessor_content_hash=d.content_hash
         AND (
    (d.source='owner-notes'
      AND json_valid(d.meta)
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.category')='lesson'
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via') IN ('local_mcp','remote_mcp')
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.written_by') IN ('owner_assistant','connector'))
    OR
    (d.source='curated'
      AND json_valid(d.meta)
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.category')='lesson'
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.written_by')='connector'
      AND json_type(d.meta,'$.owner_confirmed') IS NULL
      AND json_type(d.meta,'$.operative') IS NULL)
  )
    )
    AND NOT (
      d.source='owner-notes'
      AND CASE WHEN json_valid(d.meta)
               THEN json_type(d.meta,'$.supersedes') IS NOT NULL
               ELSE 0 END
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memory_supersessions current_memory
         WHERE current_memory.successor_doc_uid=d.doc_uid
           AND current_memory.successor_content_hash=d.content_hash
           AND current_memory.channel=json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via')
           AND (
    (d.source='owner-notes'
      AND d.category='lesson'
      AND json_valid(d.meta)
      AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.category')='lesson'
      AND (
        (json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via')='local_mcp'
          AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.written_by')='owner_assistant'
          AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.agent_profile')='owner-assistant')
        OR
        (json_extract(d.meta,'$.recorded_via')='remote_mcp'
          AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.written_by')='connector'
          AND json_extract(d.meta,'$.agent_profile')='structured-contributor')
      ))
  )
      )
    )
      ORDER BY top.score, top.rowid LIMIT ?2
    )
    SELECT keyword_matches.*,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM keyword_candidates) AS _keyword_candidate_count
    FROM (SELECT 1) LEFT JOIN keyword_matches ON 1 = 1
    ORDER BY score, _keyword_rowid
